text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Today's lucky food is~
Shrimp tempura♪ Shrimp tempura♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so! Ma'am!
One tempura soba, please!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting!
Here's your tempura soba~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I did it…… Huh?
Where's the shrimp tempura……?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Yeah, tempura changes with the season, so right now it's vegetables instead of shrimp!
Unable to eat her anticipated lucky food, Copano Rickey was feeling down...
